properties.notes: The comprehensive redevelopment of the former Downland House HQ office site at 49-51 Fishbourne Road East, Chichester for 37 new affordable homes comprising 30 shared ownership apartments, 5 affordable rent houses and 2 affordable rent apartments; car and cycle parking; vehicle and pedestrian access off Fishbourne Road East; landscaping; boundary treatment; amenity space and other ancillary development requirements.
